step1_analysis.circuit_type: Logic gate fragment (NOR-type pull-down with body-biased PMOS)
step1_analysis.description: A fragment of a logic gate, likely from a dynamic ALU or complex static gate, featuring parallel NMOS pull-downs and a PMOS pull-up with an explicit body bias connection to study reverse body bias effects in SOI.

paper_reference.title: Sub-500-ps 64-b ALUs in 0.18-m SOI/Bulk CMOS: Design and Scaling Trends

t_pLH.description: Low-to-high propagation delay (B falling, OUT rising)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 PMOS parameters with a 10fF load.

t_pHL.description: High-to-low propagation delay (B rising, OUT falling)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 NMOS parameters with a 10fF load. NMOS is very strong.

sky130_expected.calculation: NMOS is ~5x stronger than PMOS for equal W/L. V_th will be skewed towards GND.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Due to mobility differences and equal sizing, the trip point is below VDD/2 (0.9V).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure propagation delay and switching threshold of the gate fragment, with A=0 to avoid contention and B toggling.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for ALU gate fragment
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 OUT B STACK_NODE BODY_B sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM3 OUT A GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUT B GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Voltage sources
Vdd STACK_NODE 0 DC 1.8
Vbody BODY_B 0 DC 1.8
Va A 0 DC 0
Vb B 0 PULSE(1.8 0 100p 20p 20p 400p 1n)
Cload OUT 0 10f

.control
  * Transient analysis for delay
  tran 1p 2n
  meas tran t_pLH trig v(B) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran t_pHL trig v(B) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 fall=1

  * DC analysis for switching threshold
  dc Vb 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc V_th_switch when v(OUT)=0.9 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
